paragraphs.text: And you [did he make alive,] when ye were dead through your trespasses and sins,
paragraphs.original: Καὶ ὑμᾶς ὄντας νεκροὺς τοῖς παραπτώμασιν καὶ ταῖς ἁμαρτίαις ὑμῶν,
paragraphs.translit: Kai hymas ontas nekrous tois paraptōmasin kai tais hamartiais hymōn,

paragraphs.text: wherein ye once walked according to the course of this world, according to the prince of the powers of the air, of the spirit that now worketh in the sons of disobedience;
paragraphs.original: ἐν αἷς ποτε περιεπατήσατε κατὰ τὸν αἰῶνα τοῦ κόσμου τούτου, κατὰ τὸν ἄρχοντα τῆς ἐξουσίας τοῦ ἀέρος, τοῦ πνεύματος τοῦ νῦν ἐνεργοῦντος ἐν τοῖς υἱοῖς τῆς ἀπειθείας·
paragraphs.translit: en hais pote periepatēsate kata ton aiōna tou kosmou toutou, kata ton archonta tēs exousias tou aeros, tou pneumatos tou nyn energountos en tois hyiois tēs apeitheias·

paragraphs.text: among whom we also all once lived in the lust of our flesh, doing the desires of the flesh and of the mind, and were by nature children of wrath, even as the rest:--
paragraphs.original: ἐν οἷς καὶ ἡμεῖς πάντες ἀνεστράφημέν ποτε ἐν ταῖς ἐπιθυμίαις τῆς σαρκὸς ἡμῶν, ποιοῦντες τὰ θελήματα τῆς σαρκὸς καὶ τῶν διανοιῶν, καὶ ἤμεθα τέκνα φύσει ὀργῆς ὡς καὶ οἱ λοιποί·
paragraphs.translit: en hois kai hēmeis pantes anestraphēmen pote en tais epithymiais tēs sarkos hēmōn, poiountes ta thelēmata tēs sarkos kai tōn dianoiōn, kai ēmetha tekna physei orgēs hōs kai hoi loipoi·

paragraphs.text: but God, being rich in mercy, for his great love wherewith he loved us,
paragraphs.original: ὁ δὲ θεὸς πλούσιος ὢν ἐν ἐλέει, διὰ τὴν πολλὴν ἀγάπην αὐτοῦ ἣν ἠγάπησεν ἡμᾶς,
paragraphs.translit: ho de theos plousios ōn en eleei, dia tēn pollēn agapēn autou hēn ēgapēsen hēmas,

paragraphs.text: even when we were dead through our trespasses, made us alive together with Christ (by grace have ye been saved),
paragraphs.original: καὶ ὄντας ἡμᾶς νεκροὺς τοῖς παραπτώμασιν συνεζωοποίησεν τῷ Χριστῷ— χάριτί ἐστε σεσῳσμένοι—
paragraphs.translit: kai ontas hēmas nekrous tois paraptōmasin synezōopoiēsen tō Christō— chariti este sesōsmenoi—

paragraphs.text: and raised us up with him, and made us to sit with him in the heavenly [places], in Christ Jesus:
paragraphs.original: καὶ συνήγειρεν καὶ συνεκάθισεν ἐν τοῖς ἐπουρανίοις ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ,
paragraphs.translit: kai synēgeiren kai synekathisen en tois epouraniois en Christō Iēsou,

paragraphs.text: that in the ages to come he might show the exceeding riches of his grace in kindness toward us in Christ Jesus:
paragraphs.original: ἵνα ἐνδείξηται ἐν τοῖς αἰῶσιν τοῖς ἐπερχομένοις τὸ ὑπερβάλλον πλοῦτος τῆς χάριτος αὐτοῦ ἐν χρηστότητι ἐφʼ ἡμᾶς ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ.
paragraphs.translit: hina endeixētai en tois aiōsin tois eperchomenois to hyperballon ploutos tēs charitos autou en chrēstotēti ephʼ hēmas en Christō Iēsou.

paragraphs.text: for by grace have ye been saved through faith; and that not of yourselves, [it is] the gift of God;
paragraphs.original: τῇ γὰρ χάριτί ἐστε σεσῳσμένοι διὰ πίστεως· καὶ τοῦτο οὐκ ἐξ ὑμῶν, θεοῦ τὸ δῶρον·
paragraphs.translit: tē gar chariti este sesōsmenoi dia pisteōs· kai touto ouk ex hymōn, theou to dōron·

paragraphs.text: not of works, that no man should glory.
paragraphs.original: οὐκ ἐξ ἔργων, ἵνα μή τις καυχήσηται.
paragraphs.translit: ouk ex ergōn, hina mē tis kauchēsētai.

paragraphs.text: For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus for good works, which God afore prepared that we should walk in them.
paragraphs.original: αὐτοῦ γάρ ἐσμεν ποίημα, κτισθέντες ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ ἐπὶ ἔργοις ἀγαθοῖς οἷς προητοίμασεν ὁ θεὸς ἵνα ἐν αὐτοῖς περιπατήσωμεν.
paragraphs.translit: autou gar esmen poiēma, ktisthentes en Christō Iēsou epi ergois agathois hois proētoimasen ho theos hina en autois peripatēsōmen.

paragraphs.text: Wherefore remember, that once ye, the Gentiles in the flesh, who are called Uncircumcision by that which is called Circumcision, in the flesh, made by hands;
paragraphs.original: Διὸ μνημονεύετε ὅτι ποτὲ ὑμεῖς τὰ ἔθνη ἐν σαρκί, οἱ λεγόμενοι ἀκροβυστία ὑπὸ τῆς λεγομένης περιτομῆς ἐν σαρκὶ χειροποιήτου,
paragraphs.translit: Dio mnēmoneuete hoti pote hymeis ta ethnē en sarki, hoi legomenoi akrobystia hypo tēs legomenēs peritomēs en sarki cheiropoiētou,

paragraphs.text: that ye were at that time separate from Christ, alienated from the commonwealth of Israel, and strangers from the covenants of the promise, having no hope and without God in the world.
paragraphs.original: ὅτι ἦτε τῷ καιρῷ ἐκείνῳ χωρὶς Χριστοῦ, ἀπηλλοτριωμένοι τῆς πολιτείας τοῦ Ἰσραὴλ καὶ ξένοι τῶν διαθηκῶν τῆς ἐπαγγελίας, ἐλπίδα μὴ ἔχοντες καὶ ἄθεοι ἐν τῷ κόσμῳ.
paragraphs.translit: hoti ēte tō kairō ekeinō chōris Christou, apēllotriōmenoi tēs politeias tou Israēl kai xenoi tōn diathēkōn tēs epangelias, elpida mē echontes kai atheoi en tō kosmō.

paragraphs.text: But now in Christ Jesus ye that once were far off are made nigh in the blood of Christ.
paragraphs.original: νυνὶ δὲ ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ ὑμεῖς οἵ ποτε ὄντες μακρὰν ἐγενήθητε ἐγγὺς ἐν τῷ αἵματι τοῦ Χριστοῦ.
paragraphs.translit: nyni de en Christō Iēsou hymeis hoi pote ontes makran egenēthēte engys en tō haimati tou Christou.

paragraphs.text: For he is our peace, who made both one, and brake down the middle wall of partition,
paragraphs.original: αὐτὸς γάρ ἐστιν ἡ εἰρήνη ἡμῶν, ὁ ποιήσας τὰ ἀμφότερα ἓν καὶ τὸ μεσότοιχον τοῦ φραγμοῦ λύσας, τὴν ἔχθραν ἐν τῇ σαρκὶ αὐτοῦ,
paragraphs.translit: autos gar estin hē eirēnē hēmōn, ho poiēsas ta amphotera hen kai to mesotoichon tou phragmou lysas, tēn echthran en tē sarki autou,

paragraphs.text: having abolished in the flesh the enmity, [even] the law of commandments [contained] in ordinances; that he might create in himself of the two one new man, [so] making peace;
paragraphs.original: τὸν νόμον τῶν ἐντολῶν ἐν δόγμασιν καταργήσας, ἵνα τοὺς δύο κτίσῃ ἐν αὑτῷ εἰς ἕνα καινὸν ἄνθρωπον ποιῶν εἰρήνην,
paragraphs.translit: ton nomon tōn entolōn en dogmasin katargēsas, hina tous dyo ktisē en hautō eis hena kainon anthrōpon poiōn eirēnēn,

paragraphs.text: and might reconcile them both in one body unto God through the cross, having slain the enmity thereby:
paragraphs.original: καὶ ἀποκαταλλάξῃ τοὺς ἀμφοτέρους ἐν ἑνὶ σώματι τῷ θεῷ διὰ τοῦ σταυροῦ ἀποκτείνας τὴν ἔχθραν ἐν αὐτῷ·
paragraphs.translit: kai apokatallaxē tous amphoterous en heni sōmati tō theō dia tou staurou apokteinas tēn echthran en autō·

paragraphs.text: and he came and preached peace to you that were far off, and peace to them that were nigh:
paragraphs.original: καὶ ἐλθὼν εὐηγγελίσατο εἰρήνην ὑμῖν τοῖς μακρὰν καὶ εἰρήνην τοῖς ἐγγύς·
paragraphs.translit: kai elthōn euēngelisato eirēnēn hymin tois makran kai eirēnēn tois engys·

paragraphs.text: for through him we both have our access in one Spirit unto the Father.
paragraphs.original: ὅτι διʼ αὐτοῦ ἔχομεν τὴν προσαγωγὴν οἱ ἀμφότεροι ἐν ἑνὶ πνεύματι πρὸς τὸν πατέρα.
paragraphs.translit: hoti diʼ autou echomen tēn prosagōgēn hoi amphoteroi en heni pneumati pros ton patera.

paragraphs.text: So then ye are no more strangers and sojourners, but ye are fellow-citizens with the saints, and of the household of God,
paragraphs.original: ἄρα οὖν οὐκέτι ἐστὲ ξένοι καὶ πάροικοι, ἀλλὰ ἐστὲ συμπολῖται τῶν ἁγίων καὶ οἰκεῖοι τοῦ θεοῦ,
paragraphs.translit: ara oun ouketi este xenoi kai paroikoi, alla este sympolitai tōn hagiōn kai oikeioi tou theou,

paragraphs.text: being built upon the foundation of the apostles and prophets, Christ Jesus himself being the chief corner stone;
paragraphs.original: ἐποικοδομηθέντες ἐπὶ τῷ θεμελίῳ τῶν ἀποστόλων καὶ προφητῶν, ὄντος ἀκρογωνιαίου αὐτοῦ Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ,
paragraphs.translit: epoikodomēthentes epi tō themeliō tōn apostolōn kai prophētōn, ontos akrogōniaiou autou Christou Iēsou,

paragraphs.text: in whom each several building, fitly framed together, groweth into a holy temple in the Lord;
paragraphs.original: ἐν ᾧ πᾶσα οἰκοδομὴ συναρμολογουμένη αὔξει εἰς ναὸν ἅγιον ἐν κυρίῳ,
paragraphs.translit: en hō pasa oikodomē synarmologoumenē auxei eis naon hagion en kyriō,

paragraphs.text: in whom ye also are builded together for a habitation of God in the Spirit.
paragraphs.original: ἐν ᾧ καὶ ὑμεῖς συνοικοδομεῖσθε εἰς κατοικητήριον τοῦ θεοῦ ἐν πνεύματι.
paragraphs.translit: en hō kai hymeis synoikodomeisthe eis katoikētērion tou theou en pneumati.
